jp: <STBG 7,0><NAME 7>I am the bone of my sword...
Unknown to Death. Nor known to Life

Hey, on the ground...
something looks like it's stuck in it...

<ITEM PCOIN00054,1,1>Wait, is this... a sword!?
And so many of them...

<TALK 5><NAME 10><CHAR 5,5,7,0,0><CV 5,25>Hmm...
so this is the place in question...

<TALK 1><NAME 1><ITEM PCOIN00054,1,1>Dr. Andra!
What in the world is this...?

<TALK 5><NAME 10><CV 5,35>Hmm, a gilded monster,
and swords stuck in the wasteland...

This resembles a legend
of a struggle over a chalice.

<ITEM 0,1,0><CV 5,26>According to the tablet, if this
struggle continues, evil will overflow
and swallow the world. This is dire...

<CV 5,7>Both of you, I ask you to slay that
gilded monster and recover the ≪Projection≫
swords stuck in the wasteland.

<ITEM WD_WSWORD181,1,1><CV 5,20>As thanks, though it is a poor word,
I'll give you the legendary gear left
from the struggle over the chalice.
<ITEM 0,1,0><TALK 5><NAME 10><CV 5,19>Both of you, I leave it to you!
